name: ThreadFox Lite
tagline: Free, read-only Reddit research: subreddit rules, communities, account standing and post status
description: Read-only Reddit tools for planning posts that communities accept. subreddit_rules returns a subreddit's rules, size and description with self-promotion rules flagged; find_communities lists subreddits for a topic with their promotion rules; account_check reports an account's age, karma and whether recent posts are removed or hidden; post_status says whether a post is still live, removed or deleted. It reads through your own signed-in Chrome via Microsoft's Playwright Extension (one-time setup), never posts, votes or changes anything, and needs no Reddit API keys.
